name: Rod Maz
bio:
Rod Maz is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in Buenos Aires City, Argentina, specializing in illustrative styles. He is known for his high level of respect for his clients, as indicated in his mantra, "Respect Above ALL." Also, he seems to be an integral member of the ProTeam at Emalla. Rod Maz brings magic to his work, as seen in his unique "Callisattva" and "Calligraffiti" designs, driven by a deep dedication to his craft.
Price: $$
Current location: Buenos Aires City, Buenos Aires Autonomous City, Argentina
